title: Shared Foundation Consolidation: four authoritative cross-LandOS contracts

workstreams.name: Contract 1: Canonical Subject State
workstreams.operatorOutcome: One typed authoritative Subject State (subjectResolved distinct from officiallyVerified, APN, situs, county, state, FIPS, ZIP, owner, governing acreage, provenance/confidence) is consumed by the readiness checklist, dossier, resolution endpoint, intelligence-run identity, and UI, so a research-grade established subject never reads as no subject downstream, and one governing acreage number appears consistently across surfaces.
inScope: Evolve canonical-identity.ts into the single authoritative CanonicalSubjectState (add fips, subjectResolved, officiallyVerified, governingAcreage from the shared acreage basis, seller-communications availability signal)

Migrate the remaining independent identity deciders to consume it: routes.ts resolution endpoint (verified_property AND spine contradiction), property-intelligence-live.ts snapshot identity, public-property-intelligence subject gate inputs, opportunity-discovery-package resolutionStatus

Make the governing acreage number (not just the basis label) flow from acreage-basis into canonical state so header/spine/snapshot/valuation read the same number; survey governs per doctrine without GIS-mismatch blockers

Verify then remove dead resolution infrastructure: parallel-resolution-lanes.ts, dead resolver core of parallel-resolution.ts (retain haversineMeters), dead core of property-resolution-engine.ts (retain live re-exports/types), resolution-snapshot dead write path
Focused regression tests: subject resolved while officiallyVerified=false; migrated consumers agree; governing acreage consistent; fresh survey governs without blocker
frontendScreens: Acquisition Workspace V2 Research Readiness checklist
workstreams.requiredDataState: A current representative deal with resolved subject identity (research-grade, official verification may be outstanding); existing accepted operator data untouched.

steps: Open Acquisition Workspace V2 for a deal whose subject resolved via Property Resolution without official assessor confirmation
Confirm the subject panel, research readiness checklist, and resolution state all present the same established subject (no 'no canonical subject' anywhere)
Confirm acreage shown in the header, overview, and property intelligence surfaces is the same governing number with its basis
Hard refresh and confirm identical subject and acreage
Check console for new errors and confirm no research reruns triggered by these reads

testRequirements: Test: resolveCanonicalIdentity/subject state reports subjectResolved=true with officiallyVerified=false for a spine-confirmed, non-verified_property card
Test: resolution endpoint and readiness reconcile agree with canonical subject state (no verified_property AND-gate contradiction)
Test: governing acreage from a subject-matching recorded survey wins over GIS/assessor without raising an operator blocker
Test: removed dead modules have no remaining imports (compile + suite green after removal)
failureConditions: Any migrated consumer still reports no subject for a resolved research-grade subject
Different acreage numbers on different surfaces for the same deal
A live import is deleted or accepted operator data changes

requirements.text: One typed CanonicalSubjectState with subjectResolved distinct from officiallyVerified is the shared identity answer.
Readiness, resolution endpoint, dossier, snapshot identity, and discovery-package consumers consume it instead of re-deciding identity.
Governing acreage is a single consistent conclusion across surfaces; survey governs per doctrine.
Verified-dead resolution engines/snapshot write paths are removed with proof of no live references.

workstreams.name: Contract 2: Declared Capability Prerequisites
workstreams.operatorOutcome: Capabilities and readiness items declare the minimum context they need (county, ZIP, owner, parcel, seller communications); the readiness manifest computes for a deal without parcel identity, county/ZIP market work and seller work proceed while parcel-specific research waits on its own prerequisite, and the mission graph no longer skips county-scoped market intelligence for lack of a parcel.
inScope: Add a declared prerequisites field to capability metadata (capability-contract.ts) and populate it for the 11 registered capabilities

Add per-item prerequisites to ResearchReadinessItemDefinition; reconcileResearchReadiness stops 409ing the whole manifest without a subject card and instead evaluates each item against CanonicalSubjectState
Relax the route-level dealCardAssessorTaxSubject gate only where the target capability's declared prerequisites are met without a subject card (parcel-specific routes keep waiting)
Mission graph: market_intelligence child stops hard-depending on parcel_identity (county-known prerequisite; awaits ordering only); parcel-scoped children keep their dependency
Coverage cycle stops aborting wholesale on a missing manifest subject
Regression tests for prerequisite planning; preserve phase5-parallel-dispatch behavior
frontendScreens: Acquisition Workspace V2 Research Readiness checklist for a fresh county-known lead without parcel resolution
workstreams.requiredDataState: A fresh disposable test lead with county+state known but no resolved parcel identity (created for this sprint; clearly marked as test data), plus an existing resolved deal for the parcel-gated contrast.

steps: Create/open the disposable county-known lead in Acquisition Workspace V2
Confirm the research readiness checklist renders a real manifest (not an error) with market/seller items evaluable and parcel-specific items honestly waiting on subject establishment
Confirm a county-scoped market item is actionable/attemptable without parcel identity
Open the resolved contrast deal and confirm parcel-specific items remain properly gated and unchanged
Hard refresh both and confirm persistence; console clean; no unintended research reruns

testRequirements: Test: county-only readiness items compute and are attemptable with county known and no parcel
Test: ZIP-scoped market prerequisite satisfied by ZIP alone
Test: parcel-specific capability prerequisites unmet without established subject; met once established
Test: seller item does not require parcel
Test: mission graph plan does not skip market_intelligence when parcel_identity is unresolved but county is known
failureConditions: Manifest still 409s wholesale without a subject card
Parcel-specific research runs without an established subject
Market intelligence still skipped by parcel_identity dependency

requirements.text: Capability metadata declares minimum required context; orchestrator/readiness use declarations to decide what can run now.
Research Readiness computes per-item without parcel identity; county/ZIP/seller items no longer invalidated by a missing parcel.
Mission graph runs county-scoped market intelligence when county is known while parcel lanes wait on their own prerequisite.
Parcel-specific capabilities still gate correctly on established subject.

workstreams.name: Contract 3: Durable run identity and real cancellation
workstreams.operatorOutcome: Intelligence runs have durable authoritative identity: refresh rejoins the live run, restart does not leave a phantom forever-running run, the operator can genuinely cancel a run, and no superseded/timed-out/cancelled run can overwrite newer derived intelligence or evidence.
inScope: Make the intelligence-stack finalization run durable (reuse the landos_property_intelligence_run pattern/store rather than inventing a new one) with runId, status lifecycle, abandonment ceiling, and cancellation state

Add run attribution + authority guard to the unguarded shared write paths: writeDerivedSnapshot, appendDerivedEvidence, persistAcquisitionIntelligence, GEV investigation writes; reject writes from non-authoritative runs
Close the updateSpecialist late-write gap (status check)
Genuine cancellation endpoint for the intelligence run; AbortSignal propagation where supported (Hermes CLI invoke signal); timeout paths mark supersession so orphaned work cannot write later
Preserve current progress behavior exactly: pending/running/complete/failed/skipped, elapsed time, refresh-safe rejoin, side-effect-free polling, honest completion clearing
frontendScreens: Acquisition Workspace V2 Deal read/run status (http://localhost:3141/dept/acquisitions/v2?deal=<current>)
workstreams.requiredDataState: A current representative deal able to run the intelligence stack; the disposable test lead may be used for cancellation without touching accepted intelligence.

steps: Start an intelligence run; confirm stage progress and elapsed time render as today
Hard refresh mid-run and confirm rejoin to the same run with correct progress and no duplicate run started
Cancel the run from the operator surface; confirm it reports cancelled promptly and derived intelligence/evidence show no writes from the cancelled run afterward
Run again to completion; confirm completed intelligence is current immediately and after refresh
Confirm no run row appears to run forever after the cancel/timeout scenarios; console clean

testRequirements: Test: write from a superseded runId into derived snapshots is rejected while the authoritative run's write lands
Test: cancelled run cannot perform an authoritative late write
Test: abandonment ceiling supersedes a wedged run so a new run can start and the old one cannot write
Test: progress reducer behavior unchanged (existing intelligence-run-progress tests stay green)
Test: updateSpecialist refuses writes to a non-running run
failureConditions: A superseded or cancelled run's write lands in derived intelligence/evidence
Cancellation only stops polling while work keeps writing
Refresh rejoin or progress states regress
A run wedges as running forever after restart

requirements.text: Intelligence runs have durable run identity with lifecycle, abandonment ceiling, and cancellation state.
All shared derived-intelligence/evidence write paths are run-authority guarded; superseded/cancelled/late writes are rejected.
A genuine cancellation endpoint exists and AbortSignal reaches interruptible layers.
Existing progress UX (states, elapsed, rejoin, honest clearing) is preserved.

workstreams.name: Contract 4: Unified evidence admission and one result vocabulary
workstreams.operatorOutcome: All Deal research facts enter through one admission contract over the canonical evidence table with run/capability attribution and shared verification/confidence semantics; Research Readiness reports RETURNED only when required evidence actually landed; valid browser/adaptive findings are promotable into canonical evidence instead of dying as conversation.
inScope: Create writeEvidence admission contract evolving landos_property_evidence_item: add originating capability + runId attribution, shared verification-status and confidence enums (normalizing the two ladder spellings), optional claim wording; migrate the existing seven writers through it
Wire the existing answered concept at the production call site so a completed lane with no usable evidence is PARTIAL, not RETURNED
Unified result vocabulary mapping (RETURNED/PARTIAL/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED/NOT_APPLICABLE/NEEDS_OPERATOR_ACTION/FAILED) over existing subsystem statuses, consumed by readiness and the operator projection
Promotion bridge: valid browser facts (landos_browser_fact) admitted into canonical evidence with provenance, then readiness reconciled

Connect the existing adaptive-research-recovery outcome/eligibility types into the shared result contract to the extent needed for readiness honesty (no new recovery framework, no new specialist agents)
frontendScreens: Acquisition Workspace V2 Research Readiness checklist and evidence surfaces for a current deal
workstreams.requiredDataState: A current representative deal with mixed lane outcomes (some evidence-backed, at least one attempted-without-evidence scenario reproducible via the disposable test lead).

steps: Open the readiness checklist for a deal where a lane completed without landing usable evidence; confirm it reads as partial/unresolved, not returned
Confirm an evidence-backed item reads returned with its source and confidence visible
Promote/produce a browser-derived fact and confirm it appears in canonical evidence surfaces with provenance and the readiness item reconciles
Hard refresh and confirm all statuses persist; console clean; no research reruns from reads

testRequirements: Test: deterministic and adaptive/browser evidence both enter through writeEvidence with subject scope, capability, and runId retained
Test: completed-with-no-evidence lane maps to PARTIAL and does not satisfy readiness
Test: BLOCKED, NOT_APPLICABLE, NEEDS_OPERATOR_ACTION, PARTIAL remain distinguishable end-to-end into the operator projection
Test: confidence/verification enums normalize both existing ladder spellings without data loss
failureConditions: Any production lane still counts as RETURNED without recognized evidence
Evidence rows lose run/capability attribution or subject scope
Browser facts remain unreachable from canonical evidence
Existing evidence rows corrupted or accepted operator facts changed

requirements.text: One writeEvidence admission contract over the canonical evidence table carries scope, source, provenance, confidence, verification, tier, claim, supersession, capability, and runId.
Worker-ran is not returned: readiness requires recognized landed evidence via the wired answered concept.
One result vocabulary distinguishes RETURNED/PARTIAL/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED/NOT_APPLICABLE/NEEDS_OPERATOR_ACTION/FAILED across subsystems.
Valid browser/adaptive findings are admitted into canonical evidence and reconcile readiness.
